blocks.text: Kyla Fox Centre is a private eating disorder treatment centre based in Toronto, Canada, that caters exclusively to women. The centre offers treatment for various eating disorders, such as anorexia, bulimia, binge eating disorder, ARFID, over-exercise addiction, orthorexia, and negative body image, among others. The unique feature of the centre is that it offers individualized treatment programs, including a virtual program for adults and adolescents that provides support for 21 days. Clients can expect a thoughtful plan for their ongoing care, transition, or termination after week three, and supervised meal times can be in a virtual group or individual setting, depending on the client’s preference.

sections.heading: Intensive Clinical Therapy at Kyla Fox Centre

blocks.text: The centre provides intensive clinical therapy to help clients uncover the underlying issues motivating their addictions. The therapy approach used depends on the individual’s situation and may include cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), narrative therapy, solution-focused therapy, trauma-focused therapy, and interpersonal psychotherapy (IPT). Kyla Fox Centre places a strong emphasis on addressing the root causes of addiction and offers ongoing support to clients as they go through the recovery process.

sections.heading: Holistic Healing at Kyla Fox Centre

blocks.text: Kyla Fox Centre offers holistic healing treatments in addition to its intensive clinical therapy. The holistic healing programme includes private yoga sessions, private nutrition sessions, acupuncture, Reiki, art therapy, and naturopathy. Clients will also participate in weekly meal planning and preparation activities, such as private cooking sessions, grocery store visits, and nutrition house calls. The holistic healing approach ensures that clients receive the physical and emotional support they need to manage their addictions.

centre.about_html:
Kyla Fox Centre: An Introduction

Kyla Fox Centre is a private eating disorder treatment centre based in Toronto, Canada, that caters exclusively to women. The centre offers treatment for various eating disorders, such as anorexia, bulimia, binge eating disorder, ARFID, over-exercise addiction, orthorexia, and negative body image, among others. The unique feature of the centre is that it offers individualized treatment programs, including a virtual program for adults and adolescents that provides support for 21 days. Clients can expect a thoughtful plan for their ongoing care, transition, or termination after week three, and supervised meal times can be in a virtual group or individual setting, depending on the client’s preference.

Intensive Clinical Therapy at Kyla Fox Centre

The centre provides intensive clinical therapy to help clients uncover the underlying issues motivating their addictions. The therapy approach used depends on the individual’s situation and may include cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), narrative therapy, solution-focused therapy, trauma-focused therapy, and interpersonal psychotherapy (IPT). Kyla Fox Centre places a strong emphasis on addressing the root causes of addiction and offers ongoing support to clients as they go through the recovery process.

Holistic Healing at Kyla Fox Centre

Kyla Fox Centre offers holistic healing treatments in addition to its intensive clinical therapy. The holistic healing programme includes private yoga sessions, private nutrition sessions, acupuncture, Reiki, art therapy, and naturopathy. Clients will also participate in weekly meal planning and preparation activities, such as private cooking sessions, grocery store visits, and nutrition house calls. The holistic healing approach ensures that clients receive the physical and emotional support they need to manage their addictions.

Compassionate and Personalized Care

Kyla Fox Centre acknowledges that every individual’s journey with addiction is different, and their compassionate care is well-rounded to address the unique concerns of each client. They offer outpatient care and support for clients looking for help with their addiction in a non-residential setting. The centre’s personalized care encompasses both intensive clinical therapy and holistic healing to address the physical, emotional, and psychological elements of addiction.

Kyla Fox Centre - Center Overview

The Kyla Fox Centre is a leading rehab center that specializes in treating eating disorders through its outpatient treatment center in Toronto. They understand the individual needs of each patient and provide personalized treatment for those suffering from eating disorders. Their unique treatment plan is tailored to the specific impact of each person’s harm and other related factors such as life commitments and protective factors.

 

The center provides care for the entire spectrum of eating disorders, including anorexia, bulimia, binge eating disorder, ARFID, over-exercise addiction, orthorexia, negative body image, and any preoccupation with food and the body. Throughout treatment, their team supports patients as well as their loved ones because they recognize the impact that eating disorders can have on relationships. The Kyla Fox Centre operates virtually to provide clinical and holistic services to patients accessing help while staying safe within the pandemic guidelines.

Kyla Fox Centre: An Introduction

Kyla Fox Centre is a private eating disorder treatment centre based in Toronto, Canada, that caters exclusively to women. The centre offers treatment for various eating disorders, such as anorexia, bulimia, binge eating disorder, ARFID, over-exercise addiction, orthorexia, and negative body image, among others. The unique feature of the centre is that it offers individualized treatment programs, including a virtual program for adults and adolescents that provides support for 21 days. Clients can expect a thoughtful plan for their ongoing care, transition, or termination after week three, and supervised meal times can be in a virtual group or individual setting, depending on the client’s preference.

Intensive Clinical Therapy at Kyla Fox Centre

The centre provides intensive clinical therapy to help clients uncover the underlying issues motivating their addictions. The therapy approach used depends on the individual’s situation and may include cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), narrative therapy, solution-focused therapy, trauma-focused therapy, and interpersonal psychotherapy (IPT). Kyla Fox Centre places a strong emphasis on addressing the root causes of addiction and offers ongoing support to clients as they go through the recovery process.

Holistic Healing at Kyla Fox Centre

Kyla Fox Centre offers holistic healing treatments in addition to its intensive clinical therapy. The holistic healing programme includes private yoga sessions, private nutrition sessions, acupuncture, Reiki, art therapy, and naturopathy. Clients will also participate in weekly meal planning and preparation activities, such as private cooking sessions, grocery store visits, and nutrition house calls. The holistic healing approach ensures that clients receive the physical and emotional support they need to manage their addictions.

Compassionate and Personalized Care

Kyla Fox Centre acknowledges that every individual’s journey with addiction is different, and their compassionate care is well-rounded to address the unique concerns of each client. They offer outpatient care and support for clients looking for help with their addiction in a non-residential setting. The centre’s personalized care encompasses both intensive clinical therapy and holistic healing to address the physical, emotional, and psychological elements of addiction.

Kyla Fox Centre - Center Overview

The Kyla Fox Centre is a leading rehab center that specializes in treating eating disorders through its outpatient treatment center in Toronto. They understand the individual needs of each patient and provide personalized treatment for those suffering from eating disorders. Their unique treatment plan is tailored to the specific impact of each person’s harm and other related factors such as life commitments and protective factors.

 

The center provides care for the entire spectrum of eating disorders, including anorexia, bulimia, binge eating disorder, ARFID, over-exercise addiction, orthorexia, negative body image, and any preoccupation with food and the body. Throughout treatment, their team supports patients as well as their loved ones because they recognize the impact that eating disorders can have on relationships. The Kyla Fox Centre operates virtually to provide clinical and holistic services to patients accessing help while staying safe within the pandemic guidelines.
